text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and D at gains felt satisfying, but I should base future sales on each stock’s outlook and portfolio needs, not on the pleasure of locking in gains.","My loss aversion can make losses feel especially painful; I should avoid letting that feeling alone keep me from making a sound decision.","I made no trades through several periods of volatility, so I should keep a long-term perspective and trade deliberately rather than react to short-term moves."]}
